facts.summary: Primary endpoint met at one dose with modest effect · Phase 2 · ML-007C-MA in schizophrenia · not yet approved

evidence.summary: ZEPHYR met its primary endpoint and demonstrated a substantial treatment effect, supported by concordant improvements across key secondary efficacy measures
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: PANSS Total Score (mITT, primary endpoint): Effect Size of 0.37 (-4.5 pts versus placebo, p=0.015)
evidence.safety: No serious or drug-related severe AEs
evidence.program_discontinued: Data support advancing to an additional pivotal trial to support registration; planning and site identification underway ahead of EOP2 FDA interactions
